semantics.definition: One independently acting body is visibly assembled from clay, stone, earth, wood, or another nonliving material and remains materially continuous through its joints. Construction seams, activation response, grounded motion, and task consequence establish agency; a statue, costume, metal robot, rubble pile, or sacred inscription alone does not.
paraphrase_examples: 점토나 돌 조각이 관절까지 재료적으로 이어진 한 몸을 이루고 활성화 반응과 실제 과업 흔적을 남기는 골렘
one assembled nonliving-material body with coherent joints, activation response, grounded motion, and task consequence
contrast_examples: a pile of rubble with glowing symbols

match_terms: one complete humanoid or creature body is assembled from nonliving material
비생물 재료로 조립된 완전한 인물형 또는 생물형 몸 하나
the same clay stone earth or wood continues across torso limbs and joints
같은 점토 돌 흙 또는 목재가 몸통 팔다리와 관절을 연속 통과
seams fitted blocks packed clay or bindings reveal deliberate construction
이음선 맞물린 블록 다져진 점토 또는 결속이 의도적 제작을 드러냄
posture contact shadow and displaced material show independent motion

one handled load opened path or moved obstacle proves a completed task

obligations.instruction: Show the whole constructed body, readable material joints and seams, grounded contact shadow, an active interaction with one object, and the resulting moved load or cleared obstacle without relying on copied sacred writing.

render_gates.description: One complete constructed body reads as a single agent.
Material remains continuous across torso, limbs, and joints.
Seams, fitted blocks, packed clay, or bindings show deliberate assembly.
Grounded motion and one object interaction demonstrate independent agency.
A statue, costume, robot, rubble pile, or inscription alone does not substitute.
